answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue gains among established customers without measurable retention harm, supporting sustainability. Memory 44 also strongly supports qualified revenue through improved enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, though long-term revenue outcomes are not stated. Memories 86 and 31 show durable or meaningful activation improvements, which can support revenue indirectly, but they omit qualified-revenue and retention evidence. Memory 91 is similarly indirect, with no revenue or durability evidence beyond week-one engagement. Memory 73 is least supported because it reports acquisition and revenue lift from promotional pricing but omits retention, margin, customer quality, and long-term sustainability—especially important for price-sensitive segments facing aggressive competitor pricing.
